newsitem.title: USA: Getty Communications Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Getty Communications Q3 net rises.

text.p: Getty Communications Plc said on Monday that its third quarter net rose to 255,000 stg from 74,000 stg a year earlier.

It said the rise occurred despite an increase in depreciation charges to 929,000 stg from 597,000 stg due to increased capital expenditure and investment in duplicate transparencies, keywording and scanning.
Sales for the quarter rose to 14.3 million stg from 10.2 million stg a year earlier.
Getty Communications is a London-based provider of visual content to advertising and design agencies and the publishing industry.
